items.title: Hydrogen production by alginate-immobilized Chlorella vulgaris under nutrient-replete conditions.
items.hook: Demonstrated hydrogen production by alginate-immobilized Chlorella vulgaris under nutrient-replete conditions, avoiding nutrient-starvation steps.

items.title: Light quality regulates extracellular polymeric substances and cell wall compositions to trigger distinct auto-flocculation strategies for Tetradesmus obliquus.
items.hook: Showed that light quality regulates extracellular polymeric substances and cell wall composition, enabling distinct auto-flocculation strategies for Tetradesmus obliquus.

items.title: Sodium acetate-driven mixotrophy of Chlorella sorokiniana enables integrated bioremediation, biorefinery and bioflocculation in digested sludge liquor.
items.hook: Sodium acetate-driven mixotrophy of Chlorella sorokiniana enabled integrated bioremediation, biorefinery and bioflocculation in digested sludge liquor.

items.title: Transcriptomic insights into fermented Spirulina-mediated remodelling of lipid homeostasis to alleviate glucose-induced hyperlipidemia.
items.hook: Transcriptomic analysis shows Spirulina fermentation remodels lipid metabolism to reduce glucose-induced hyperlipidemia.

items.title: Physical and Chemical Characteristics of Fat From Different Tissues Obtained by Pigs Fed Diets With a Partial to Total Replacement of Soybean Meal With Spirulina Powder.
items.journal: Journal of animal physiology and animal nutrition
items.hook: Replacing soybean meal with Spirulina powder alters physicochemical properties of pig fat from different tissues.

items.title: NaCl-Mediated Multilevel Regulation of Astaxanthin Biosynthesis in Haematococcus lacustris under High-Light Stress: Multiomics Mechanism Elucidation and Industrial-Scale Validation of Astaxanthin Production.
items.journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
items.hook: High‑salinity stress enhances astaxanthin production in Haematococcus lacustris, validated at industrial scale.

items.title: Lipidomic insights into algal responses to environmental stress: Analytical advances and ecotoxicological perspectives.
items.hook: The study used lipidomic profiling to reveal how micro and macroalgae alter lipid composition in response to environmental stress.

items.title: Co-metabolic removal of perfluorooctanoic acid and perfluorooctanesulfonic acid by marine diatom Chaetoceros calcitrans MZB-1 using positively-charged organic compounds and common carbon sources.
items.hook: Co-metabolism with positively-charged organic compounds and common carbon sources enabled the marine diatom Chaetoceros calcitrans to remove perfluorooctanoic and perfluorooctanesulfonic acids.

items.title: Microwave-assisted fractionation of Chlorella vulgaris using an ethylene glycol-modified deep eutectic solvent for nanocellulose production.
items.hook: Microwave-assisted fractionation of Chlorella vulgaris with an ethylene glycol-modified deep eutectic solvent produces nanocellulose from algal biomass.

items.title: Microalgae-bacteria co-culture further enhances microalgal biodiesel production under salt stress.
items.hook: Microalgae-bacteria co-culture under salt stress enhances microalgal biodiesel production by balancing lipid accumulation and growth.
